questions.question: Why use abstract classes?
questions.answer: Abstract classes provide a common base and enforce a contract for subclasses.

questions.question: What is Slow Start in TCP?
questions.answer: Slow Start is a TCP congestion control algorithm that increases the congestion window exponentially until a threshold is reached.

questions.question: What is a file descriptor?
questions.answer: A file descriptor is a unique identifier used by the operating system to access an open file.

questions.question: What is the map() function?
questions.answer: map() applies a function to every item in an iterable and returns an iterator.

questions.answer: A B+ Tree is a variation of the B-Tree where all records are stored at the leaf level and leaf nodes are linked together.
